headline: Skylight Leak Repair in Tampa: Causes, Costs and Next Steps
dek: A practical guide to common leak sources, damage signals, repair scope, and questions to ask before work begins.
body:
## Quick skylight leak checklist

Look for ceiling stains, bubbling paint, moisture between panes, damaged flashing, musty odors, and soft material around the skylight curb.

## What causes skylight leaks

Common causes include failed sealant, damaged or incorrectly integrated flashing, storm debris, condensation, drainage problems, and deterioration in adjacent roofing materials.

## What affects repair scope and cost

The final scope depends on access, the skylight assembly, flashing condition, adjacent roofing, concealed moisture, and whether replacement is required. Any numeric cost range must be reverified before publication.

## What to do next

Protect the interior where it is safe to do so, document visible damage, avoid temporary work that could conceal the source, and arrange an inspection of the skylight and surrounding roof system.
